done_when: forge doctor and forge upgrade print one suggested fast_test line for the repo's test kind: Python repos get forge test --pytest {base}; vitest or jest repos get their runner on changed files with --passWithNoTests using the repo's own install and runner; mixed repos get one part per kind; Go, Rust, Java, .NET and Ruby repos get no line; skill.md says so; new and existing client repos each have a command test

findings.body: For `uv run pytest && npm ci && ./node_modules/.bin/eslint . && npm test`, where the test script runs Vitest or Jest, the local ESLint command receives no `node-check` classification. The Python picker consequently retains ESLint while removing `npm ci` and the Node test runner (src/forge/fasttest.py:119–120). Both doctor and upgrade recommend running that picker before installation, so a clean checkout fails before reaching `npm ci`; an installed checkout runs ESLint twice. This is new evidence beyond the isolation ruling and previous npm-script example: direct local Node checks still lose their setup. Classify these checks consistently so they execute once after installation.
findings.title: Keep installation before direct Node checks in mixed suggestions

findings.body: The previous repair handles leading npm options, but `npm exec jest --workspace=web` becomes `npm exec -- jest --workspace=web --changedSince {base} --passWithNoTests`. The inserted separator turns workspace selection into a runner argument, so npm no longer executes Jest in the web workspace and its configuration can be lost. This affects both suggestion callers. The new evidence is an option after the runner: [npm's exec contract](https://docs.npmjs.com/cli/v11/commands/npm-exec/#npx-vs-npm-exec) explicitly permits npm options there before a separator. Preserve those npm options before the inserted separator as well.
findings.title: Preserve trailing npm options when inserting the exec separator

why: Repos without a quick test setting don't learn which quick test command fits them
